baseline_models.focus_anchor: جاءتهم الرسل من بين أيديهم ومن خلفهم
baseline_models.mechanism: Plural envoys reach the people through a forward/rearward field. The sequential branch of sending makes this cumulative rather than one isolated encounter, while all approaches converge on exclusive worship.

activation_trace.role: Successive groups make the plural messengers a repeated approach and link them to the later passive commissioning.
The interval between parties turns approach into a structured relational space.
What lies before or near supplies the forward direction.
What lies behind supplies the complementary rearward direction.
Submissive obedience is the single action toward which every route converges.

changed_reading.before: Messengers arrived and told the peoples to worship God alone.
changed_reading.after: Successive carriers close the forward and rearward field around the peoples, making the exclusive summons cumulative and difficult to reduce to one failed encounter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لو شاء ربنا لأنزل ملائكة فإنا بما أرسلتم به كافرون
baseline_models.mechanism: The reply makes a preferred descending medium the test of divine will, even while its passive wording recognizes a claimed commission and carried payload. The hearers claim authority to specify how their Lord must dispatch, then reject what the actual envoys carry.

activation_trace.role: Will related to a thing supplies the premise from which the hearers infer a required delivery mode.
Caused descent supplies the delivery action they demand.
Angels supply the preferred courier class used to invalidate the present envoys.
Messenger and message bind the rejected persons to the payload with which they were commissioned.
Denial that blocks truth attaches explicitly to the carried content, completing the channel veto.

changed_reading.before: They reject human messengers because they expected angels.
changed_reading.after: They turn a claim about their Lord's will into jurisdiction over His channel, acknowledge the claimed commission grammatically, and then block the payload carried through the channel they did receive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding discourse locates failure in announced covers, ear-weight, non-hearing, and a barrier, then explicitly joins an ordinary human to divine revelation. The angel demand therefore reads less like a neutral evidentiary request and more like a new rule generated inside a predeclared closure.

activation_trace.role: The demanded angel marks the alternative medium against which the reception barriers are tested.
Prevention of access turns the interval between caller and hearer into their asserted barrier.
The visibly human person supplies the medium that the reply will disqualify.
Divine report or inspiration explicitly connects that human medium to the divine source.

structural_cues: 41:5 puts covers, ear-weight, and the between-us barrier in the rejecters' own speech.
41:6 coordinates human likeness with receipt of revelation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies declared barriers and a human who receives revelation; I infer that the angel criterion externalizes prior refusal as a defect in the messenger. A live alternative is a sincere but mistaken theory of mediation, though the quoted closure makes neutrality unlikely.

changed_reading.before: Humanity appears to be their reason for doubting the messengers.
changed_reading.after: Their angel demand is a movable channel objection produced after they have already declared the human message inaccessible to heart, ear, and relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heaven and earth are commanded to come and answer that they come obediently, with willing or compelled response covering the alternatives. Against that scene, 'if our Lord willed' becomes will-language used to reserve human compliance until a preferred courier appears.

activation_trace.role: The hearers invoke divine willing as the premise for their angel-only test.
Commanded coming and answering arrival provide the nearby model of response to divine address.
Obedient yielding supplies the positive relation between command and response.
Being carried into an unwelcome act closes the alternative to willing compliance.

structural_cues: 41:11 gives a divine imperative followed by a dual declaration of obedient arrival.
The willing-or-unwilling pair precedes the warning and messenger account in 41:13-14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine command and exhaustive modes of coming; I infer that this scene calibrates the rejecters' appeal to what their Lord would will. It may instead serve only as a creation-power display, so the contrast remains rhetorical rather than event identity.

changed_reading.before: The counterfactual asks what kind of messenger divine will would produce.
changed_reading.after: The counterfactual borrows divine will to postpone obedience, unlike a created order that comes when addressed whether willingly or under constraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus declaration of blocking truth is followed by a juridical reversal in which bodily surfaces become informed witnesses. Concealment cannot stabilize because the very boundary that might hide the act is made to speak.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the active material image latent in the declaration of rejection.
The body's outer covering becomes a witness, reversing the expected function of a surface.
Being made to speak supplies the mechanism by which the covering surface discloses.
Deliberate hiding names the failed strategy that bodily testimony defeats.

structural_cues: 41:20 makes hearing, sight, and skins testify about action.
41:21 makes God the cause of the skins' speech.
41:22 denies that concealment could prevent those faculties from witnessing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, concealment, bodily surface, and speech; I connect the focus root's covering image to later exposure. The conventional sense remains denial, but the material analogy sharpens denial into attempted suppression.

changed_reading.before: Their final clause is a settled profession of disbelief.
changed_reading.after: Their profession also performs a covering of the payload, but the surah later makes even one's outer covering disclose what was meant to remain hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact forward-and-behind field reappears as the domain beautified by attached companions, while organized noise contests the recited message. The messengers' two-sided arrival is a counter-entry into directions already interpreted by rival companions and defended acoustically.

activation_trace.role: The between-space supplies the shared field in which competing approaches operate.
The forward direction marks one side of the messengers' approach.
The rearward direction completes the field of approach.
An attached companion supplies a persistent rival interpreter beside each hearer.
Making something appear attractive supplies the companions' operation on the shared directional field.
Mixed noise supplies an active tactic for preventing the competing message from resolving.

structural_cues: 41:25 repeats the focus's forward/behind coordinates but assigns them to companions' beautification.
41:26 immediately turns reception into a coordinated contest: do not listen, make noise, perhaps prevail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact directional recurrence, companions, beautification, and competitive noise; I infer rival occupation of the hearers' interpretive surround. The coordinates may be temporal past/future rather than bodily sides, but either preserves competition over the accessible field.

changed_reading.before: Coming from before and behind means comprehensive reach.
changed_reading.after: The messengers counter-enter a forward/rearward field already beautified by rival voices, while the audience protects that occupation by drowning the message in noise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demanded terms return in reversed order: people first say their Lord is God and remain upright; only then do angels descend. Angelic descent moves from a prerequisite imposed before trust to an accompaniment downstream of avowal and steadfastness.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent supplies the demanded credential.
Angels are the class whose absence is used to reject the message.
A saying held as a committed position supplies the first step in the reversed sequence.
Upright steadiness supplies the sustained practice between avowal and descent.
Actual angelic descent now occurs after the human response rather than before it.
The requested courier class appears with reassurance rather than initial accreditation.

structural_cues: 41:14 orders the claim as Lord's will, angelic descent, then refusal.
41:30 orders the answer as saying 'our Lord is God,' steadfastness, then angelic descent.
Shared roots for saying, descent, and angels make the reversal tight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored vocabulary and opposite sequence; I infer that 41:30 answers the focus condition by relocating angels after faithful response. The descents may belong to different moments, so this reverses evidentiary logic rather than identifying events.

changed_reading.before: They insist angels must descend first if belief is warranted.
changed_reading.after: The surah returns their requested sign after avowal and steadfastness, exposing the focus reply as an inversion of the proper order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The forward-and-behind formula returns to deny falsehood any route into the descended text, while a hypothetical foreign-language form merely generates a different complaint and leaves the same ear-weight. The focus rejection is thus a receiver-side objection capable of changing form even when payload integrity is asserted.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message anchor the model in the payload explicitly rejected in the focus.
Blocking truth names the receiver-side action tested by later channel variants.
Loss of truth or stability supplies the corruption denied access to the text.
The repeated interval construction reuses the focus geometry for textual integrity.
The forward route is closed to falsehood while remaining a route from which messengers approached.
The rearward route is likewise denied to falsehood.
Descent now characterizes the protected text rather than the demanded courier.
Non-explicit speech supplies a hypothetical alternative form that still elicits complaint.
Persistent ear-weight locates the unchanged obstruction at reception.

structural_cues: 41:41 again joins disbelief to a reminder when it arrives.
41:42 repeats the focus's before/behind frame and calls the protected book a descent.
41:43 puts the speech in continuity with what earlier messengers were told.
41:44 changes the language variable but predicts another objection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directional inviolability and a counterfactual language change with unchanged obstruction; I infer that the angel counterfactual belongs to a movable family of medium objections. Protection concerns falsehood's access to the text, not guaranteed recipient understanding.

changed_reading.before: They reject the message because human delivery leaves its authority doubtful.
changed_reading.after: The content is presented as closed to falsehood from both directions while the audience can swap delivery objections; the complaint varies, but obstructed reception persists.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's botanical sheath branch rather than ordinary denial. It remains anchored in ك ف ر and gains a precise material analogue when fruit exits its covering; render it only as a qualified image for failed concealment, never as a lexical replacement for disbelief.

activation_trace.role: The fruit-covering sense supplies a branch-distant image for a declaration that tries to close over the payload.
Emergence from concealment supplies the motion by which covered content becomes manifest.
A plant's enclosing vessel supplies the material cover from which fruit nevertheless emerges.

changed_reading.before: Kafirun names a fixed state of rejecting the message.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, their declaration resembles a sheath closed over received content, but the fruit image makes such closure permeable rather than final.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain extension moves from the focus prepositions to the closing disclosure field. It remains anchored by front/behind and supported by horizons, selves, and encompassing; render it as a topology of disclosure, not proof that the phrases are lexical synonyms.

activation_trace.role: The forward direction supplies one exterior route of approach.
The rearward direction supplies the complementary exterior route.
Distant horizons expand the exterior domain beyond immediate front and rear.
The self as the thing itself adds an interior domain of disclosure.
Complete encompassing in knowledge closes the topology around every thing.

changed_reading.before: The messengers approach from two complementary directions.
changed_reading.after: Their two-sided approach becomes a local instance of disclosure across exterior horizons and interior selves within an all-encompassing field, leaving no epistemic outside created by one preferred channel.

strongest_changes: The angel criterion becomes a receiver-made channel veto formed inside declared barriers.
The same angelic descent later follows avowal and steadfastness, reversing prerequisite into accompaniment.
The before/behind field is contested by beautifying companions and noise, yet the descended payload admits no falsehood through either direction.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence repeatedly reused the focus's channel vocabulary and directional geometry while reversing who occupies the field, when angels descend, and whether obstruction belongs to payload or receiver.
remaining_uncertainties: The before/behind construction can remain spatial, temporal, or both.
The 41:30 and 41:14 angelic descents form a rhetorical reversal, not necessarily the same event or timing.
The fruit-sheath activation must remain exploratory beside the ordinary denial and covering senses of ك ف ر.
